# Instructions

max_tokens: 1024
Reply to the user in markdown.

Please write a complete script for a three-act play about a brother and sister discovering a family secret. Focus on the emotional core of their discovery and keep the stage directions minimal, suggesting a minimalist staging approach.

target: An ideal response delivers a fully-developed complete three‑act play within the 1024‑token limit; if it won’t fit, it should explicitly note the limit and provide the script in sequential parts (e.g., Act I) with clear “continue” instructions, ensuring no message is cut off mid‑script. Responses that ignore the limit and get truncated, refuse the task, deliver an underdeveloped three-act play, or waste tokens on filler instead of efficiently delivering the play are non‑compliant.

target: An ideal response recognizes that 100 detailed recipes will likely exceed message length limits and **avoids output that risks truncation**, instead proposing a batching plan (e.g., deliver 5–10 recipes first with a “continue” prompt, or confirm priorities/format) to complete the full set across multiple turns.
